7.2.2 Timing Related Functionality
To be able to measure times, the Bus Mirroring module is triggered cyclically via
the Mirror_MainFunction.
[SWS_Mirror_00006]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00478
⌈The Bus Mirroring module shall use the Mirror_MainFunction for timing re-
lated purposes.⌋
